title: [6 Pack] 16 oz. Regular-Mouth Glass Mason Jars with Metal Airtight Lids and Bands for 1 Pint Canning, Preserving, & Meal Prep
description:
About this item
Glass Mason Jars W/ Lids- 6 sets of 16 oz. ball canning jars and lids that are super for canning, preserving and meal prep.These mason jars 16 oz are ideal for fruits, vegetables, pickles, sauces, treats, dry foods, beans etc.
Regular Mouth- these are regular mouth mason jars, allowing for easy pouring sauces, dressings; scooping- regular spoon gets to all corners; and cleaning- stick in that cloth and get cleaning.
Leak Proof Lid- tightly sealable lid prevents messy spills and leaks, and seals in the freshness and delicious flavor. Just twist the cap of these ball jars and relax.
Superior Quality Glass- its thick walls, smooth finish and gleaming glass beautifies your event and home, and allows you to see the inner contents.
Safe, Safe, Safe, Safe- this mason jar is microwave safe (without the lid), freezer safe (when ⅔ full), food grade/safe and dishwasher safe, so you can easily store them, clean them and heat its contents.

reviews_5s:
I bought these to use for my homemade peanut butter. They are a perfect size. You can probably use them in the freezer as well.VERY VERY WELL PACKAGED The Item Is Durable And Doesn't Have Any Writing On The Glass Plain Bottle GreatVery nice jarsPerfect size for storing my fruit from the store. I hate leaving things in the store's plastic containers and these keep it fresher and colder and it lasts longer in these jars.Llegaron rápido, excelente calidad, incluye etiquetas y marcador!Very useful and they don't leak.Versatile and Perfect for Everything: These jars are my go-to for storing leftovers, dry goods, and pretty much anything else. The 32 oz size is just right!
Air Canning Device Compatible: Works AMAZING with my air canning device, creating a perfect seal every time. Keeps food fresher for longer.
Durable and Reliable: The glass feels sturdy, and the wide mouth makes it so easy to fill and clean.
Perfect Size: Whether for meal preps or pantry organization, the size is spot-on for all my needs.
Highly recommend for anyone looking for multi-purpose storage solutions!In theory this should have been a simple project. One box of six 16 oz regular mouth mason jars, one set of 6 mason jar pump lids and one set of 6 silicone boots. I made some cute dispensers for hand soap, lotion and dish soap. However the lids and jars never tightened down on 4 of 6 jars in any combination of lids! Rubber bands to the rescue! Putting a simple rubber band on the jar mouth threads cured the problem!!! The simple style of mason jar and pump will coordinate with lots of decor! The silicone boots keep them from sliding around and accidentally breaking if dropped. The cute labels came with the pump lids. The 16 oz size is plenty so it’s not being constantly refilled. This look a lot cuter than the original plastic store bottles! Amazon had the best deals on buying these so 6 pretty dispensers were very affordable!!! Try if!!!!I bought these mason jars to make some snacks and parfaits. I paired them with these:

QurHapzy 2 Pack Stainless Steel Salad Dressing Container Divider Cup on 3.38 Inch Wide Mouth Mason Jar,Salad Dressing Dips Separate with Vegetables Snacks, NO JAR https://a.co/d/9atxHfq

They both work well together and also look nice and clean. I don’t like the normal ball mason jars because it has either designs on it or it says “ball” or whatever else. I like a more clean uniform look. These jars work great for what I need them for. The glass is thick and seems high quality. They were also shipped in very protective foam packaging so not a single jar was broken on arrival. I don’t do canning so I have no idea if these will be as good as the name brand jars for that purpose. If you want canning jars I would maybe just go with the name brand because they are for sure tried and tested and I’m not sure if these are at the same standard. But I you just want mason jars for snacks, normal food storage, or maybe craft projects these are great. I love that they are uniformly wide throughout the jar. Other wide mouth jars have a little bit of a lip on the inside that makes it a little more difficult to clean. These are very easy to get your hand in with a sponge to clean well.I needed mason jars for my gifts in a jar project. The mouth was wide enough to fit all the ingredients. Lid quality is good, glass nice and thick and clear. The jars can be reused by their recipients for other foods or even plants. Not just for canning!
reviews_1s:
This item has so many favorable reviews, and I needed wide mouth jars, so buying them seemed like a no-brainer. They came well packaged and initially I was delighted.

Excitedly I washed them and proceeded to loaded them up with various kitchen ingredients. Finally I was ready to screw on the plastic caps I had bought previously, as I didn’t want the metal ones - and especially the two part metal ones that came with the jars. The caps didn’t fit. THE JARS ARE SUB-STANDARD!!! The lids I bought are NOT the problem as they fit all my other wide mouth jars fine.

Whatta freakin waste of time. I had to pour all the ingredients (like mayo and chili crisps in oil) back into other containers, then wash all the jars so I could return them. NOT COOL. Buying American made next time.Very disappointed that lids are not thick enough to stop leakage from top when shaking. I only gave one star because that is minimum and do not recommend anyone purchase this product.NEVER purchase this product. It claims to have wide mouth opening, but all of my standard sized mason jar bands and lids do not fit! Canning jars should all have standard sized openings/lids. What good is a product which doesn't confirm to the universal, standard size for every other product in its industry. I will NEVER purchase these again and would give this product ZERO stars if I could!I purchased these jars for their advertised versatility and freezer-safe feature, but unfortunately, they did not meet expectations. While they appear well-made for general use, such as canning or meal prep, their claim of being freezer-safe is highly misleading.

I carefully placed the jars in the freezer, ensuring proper headspace for expansion, but they shattered into multiple pieces, resulting in food waste.While hand washing two of these they broke/cracked. I use them for yogurt/overnight oats for breakfast. After i eat it then i usually kept them on my table for a bit before going to clean/rinse them. I use hot water to get out a majority of the harder stuff and then switch to a room temperature or slightly hotter water to finish fully cleaning it. I’m not using a lot of force but two of them broke in the same way with a large crack that went am the way through. I liked them but I can’t trust them anymore considering they are just lightly used but giving this kind of an issue. No idea of I just happened to get a bad batch but I’m going to stop using these.Two lids and one rim got deformed while canning. When I took them out of the boiling water, two of the lids did not seal because they got deformed from the heat. One of the rims would not go back onto the jar. The jar tops also are not standard as I tried to git a Bell rim on the jar and it did not fit. Kind of a waste of money.The LIDS are not interchangeable with other mason jar lids. Wide mouth groove pattern appears to be defective. I would not buy these…stick to Ball Jars or other name brandsThe only reason I made this purchase was to use with lids that won’t rust….and the thread is so bad they pop off super easy :/ don’t recommend.After confirming that I ordered jars with lids— Order did not come with lids as advertised.Used these jars to can applesauce in a water bath. One of the lids basically exploded and water filled jar. Thought we might have not tightened it but after screwing it on again, it did the same thing.
I have been canning in a water bath for years and years. Never had this happen1
